title: Chapter 152: The Power Of The Queen Of Insects
content:
Chapter 152: The Power Of The Queen Of Insects

Returning from the mysterious evil god sacrifice ceremony, the evil god priest and the evil god army, who were full of confidence, easily wiped out tens of thousands of Zerg puppies, and no longer took the gathered Zerg army seriously.

It seems that only one charge is needed to annihilate all the Zerg troops that have entered the city!

"Warriors of the Spirit God! Prepare to attack!"

"Kill all those damned alien god believers!"

The nearly 50,000 evil god troops began to adjust their formations and prepare to take the initiative to attack the Zerg!

Some evil god priests also joined the army, responsible for commanding operations and providing fire support. The army blessed by the evil god does not need the blessing of the priest's faith!

The evil god priest walked down the high platform, and under the protection of two thousand bear goblins, he had to follow the evil god army and command the operations!

When the evil god army and the evil god priests in the city square were all in their positions, ready to attack with murderous intent, hundreds of Zerg one-star hosts had already surrounded the air around the square.

"All troops attack!"

The evil god priest gave the order to attack!

"Boom!

!"

As the evil god priest's voice fell, a terrifying spiritual force suddenly descended on the square and the surrounding areas!

This is like a violent and unacceptable force in the world! As soon as it descended into this world, a violent explosion occurred!

If the attack of the evil god priest was a cannonball, the attack on the square now was a super-equivalent nuclear bomb attack!

A terrifying loud noise! It shook the entire area!

The nearest Zerg combat troops all crouched down to resist the powerful attack wave coming in their faces!

The houses around the square in the city collapsed in pieces!

The alliance troops standing by in formation outside the city couldn't help but crouch down and there was a commotion!

The Zerg territories, Daxia Territory and the alliance territories at a farther distance could clearly feel the horrific changes that happened here!

The Tengu clan, far away opposite the Mengzhong City, also sensed the explosion here!

This explosion came quickly and went quickly!

The center of the explosion, the square where the evil god army and the evil god sacrifice were located, seemed to have disappeared from this world again!

Hundreds of one-star Zerg hosts, who were also affected by the explosion, dragged their wounded bodies and began to fly towards the Zerg territory.

The Queen of Zerg carried its terrifying spiritual power through these hundreds of one-star hosts, and at the same time launched a violent spiritual attack on the square. The spiritual power savagely interfered with the material world, thus triggering this terrifying collision and explosion!

Although the one-star hosts were thick-skinned and strong in defense, they were too close to the explosion area and were seriously injured. They had to withdraw to the territory to recover from their injuries.

The violent collision between spiritual power and the material world, there was no fireworks, only explosions!

The strongest lethality to the center of the explosion, and the spillover damage was just some aftermath!

Wu Qing's Zerg substitute stood on the city wall without moving. Wu Cong had led the human army of Daxia to his side, and looked at the explosion in the center of the city with him.

When the dust settled, a big pit appeared at the original square location. The nearly 50,000 evil god troops and the evil god priests who entered the army all disappeared!

I don’t know whether they were blown into ashes or their physical energy was converted into system resources after death.

Wu Qing noticed that the system resources had exploded!

But under this strong explosion, nearly a thousand people survived in the big pit!

The halo above the evil god high priest and the priests who followed him flickered brightly and darkly. With the high priest as the center, an energy shield was supported, protecting them and nearly a thousand bear goblin dragon riders.

The other bear goblin dragon riders outside the energy shield disappeared like the evil god army.

The halo above the evil god high priest and the priests became dimmer and dimmer, and finally extinguished and disappeared, and the energy shield protecting them dissipated immediately.

The priests who maintained the energy shield looked a little embarrassed. Only the bear goblins were not affected under the protection of the energy shield. They were the last armed forces in the hands of the evil god priests!

Seeing the situation inside, the Zerg army of more than 100,000 gathered outside the city quickly took action and began to deploy defenses outside the city. A large number of Zerg troops went around the other side of the city.

Even if there were less than a thousand evil god troops and a small number of evil god priests left, Wu Qing would go all out. Those who could survive such a terrible explosion, I don’t know what kind of combat power they would burst out.

Moreover, Wu Qing had a surprising discovery, which made him have to annihilate the remaining evil god army!

That is, the conditions for the Zerg mother nest to upgrade to two stars have been met 10/10, and even the conditions for the mother nest to upgrade to three stars have been met 5/10!

This means that at least five three-star enemies were killed in the explosion just now!

And the real essence of the evil god army has been preserved, and there must be more than five three-star enemies in it!

As long as the remaining enemy is completely wiped out, the Zerg will be able to leapfrog two levels and achieve leapfrog development!

With a three-star nest, the Zerg base can officially evolve into a higher-level nest in the form of a den!

With a nest in the form of a den, the Zerg has entered a new era, unlocking more Zerg technology, advanced buildings and combat arms!

The overall strength of the Zerg will be unprecedentedly improved!

The Zerg will also bid farewell to the era of relying on two basic arms, the Zerg Zerg and the Zerg Hydralisk, to conquer the world!

With the existence of the system, there may be many unexpected changes, which are all exciting!

…

In the big pit at the original square of the city, the evil god priest, who was originally full of confidence, was now in disgrace. Of the various gifts bestowed by the evil god himself, only his own strength had not been downgraded, and the others had been consumed.

The situation of ordinary priests was even more miserable than his.

Only the surviving bear goblin ground dragon cavalry guards had not lost their strength and were still able to fight, enough to protect him from evacuation safely.

Thinking of the task entrusted by the spirit god, his heart seemed to fall into an ice cave!

"We can't go back if we fail the spirit god's expectations!"

"Prepare for a decisive battle!"

The evil god priest knew his fate very well and had a determination to die.

The evil god paid such a great price just for the Zerg, and now he has nothing to gain, so his fate can be imagined!

Evil god, evil god, this is not something that the local races call casually. This evil god is not a good god, it is very evil!

"For the Spirit God! Fight to the death!"

"For the Spirit God! Fight to the death!"

The Evil God Priest and the Bugbear Dragoons both responded loudly.

"It looks like they won't run away!"

Wu Qing was a little worried that the Evil God Priest would run away like last time. If those Bugbear Dragoons, who were strengthened to an unknown degree, really wanted to run, their assault capabilities would definitely be much stronger than before. Zerg puppies alone might not be able to stop them!

These Bugbear Dragoons, which were originally one-star troops, must have received more reinforcements.

Maybe the Queen of Zerg will have another big explosion!
